topic: Separating Mixtures through Filtering and Sieving
key_concepts: Filtering separates insoluble solids from liquids using filter paper or cloth
In filtering, liquid passes through the filter while insoluble solid remains in the medium
Sieving separates solid mixtures based on differences in particle size
A sieve or strainer is used when one solid is fine and another is coarse
Brewing coffee uses filtering to remove insoluble ground coffee from liquid
Workers use framed wire screens to separate stones from sand
Filtering can remove solid impurities from water
Sieving can separate seeds or pebbles from flour or ground rice
Milk from grated coconut can be separated by filtering
Calamansi seeds can be separated from calamansi juice by filtering
